GRADE 4 ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERM 3 EXAM

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

   C. Guided writing: Arabic Alphabet is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Guided writing: Arabic Alphabet.

   B. Learners should ignore Guided writing: Arabic Alphabet completely.

   D. There is no need to practise Guided writing: Arabic Alphabet.
